# context-http

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/context-http
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+; requires `rasuvaeff/context` ^0.2. Guzzle is optional (only for `ContextClient`).
- Cooperative only: adapters refuse to start work or to hand back a response
  after the context terminated; they cannot interrupt a blocking PSR-18 call.
- `ContextMiddleware` owns the request context and cancels it in `finally`.
- Every request gets a `CorrelationId` (valid header, else generated).
- An incoming budget header (`deadlineHeader`) is whole ms 1–999999999 and only
  shortens the configured timeout; anything else is ignored.
- `ContextClient` uses `http_errors => false` (4xx/5xx returned, like PSR-18).

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Context;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\ContextController;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Http\ContextClient;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Http\ContextMiddleware;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Http\CorrelationId;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Http\PreflightClient;

$middleware = new ContextMiddleware(
    timeout: 5.0,                            // float|callable(ServerRequestInterface): float
    correlationHeader: 'X-Correlation-ID',
    timeSource: null,                        // ?TimeSource
    deadlineHeader: 'X-Request-Timeout-Ms',  // ?string, null = ignore upstream budgets
    correlationIdGenerator: null,            // ?Closure(): CorrelationId, default CorrelationId::generate(...)
    responseFactory: $psr17,                 // ?ResponseFactoryInterface: expired → 504, cancelled → 499
    expiredStatus: 504,
    cancelledStatus: 499,
);
// handler: $request->getAttribute(Context::class|ContextController::class|CorrelationId::class)
// the CorrelationId is also $context->value(CorrelationId::class)

$client = new PreflightClient($psr18, $context, deadlineHeader: 'X-Request-Timeout-Ms', correlationHeader: 'X-Correlation-ID');
$client->sendRequest($request);   // assertActive() before and after; adds headers (explicit header wins)

$guzzleAdapter = new ContextClient($guzzle, deadlineHeader: null, correlationHeader: null);
$guzzleAdapter->send($request, $context);
// options: timeout/connect_timeout = remainingMs/1000, body = stream, version kept, http_errors=false
// transport failure: context expired → ContextExpiredException(previous = failure);
//                    cancelled → ContextCancelledException; else rethrown
// constructor: object without request() → InvalidArgumentException

CorrelationId::isValid($s);   // /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}\z/
CorrelationId::generate();    // 32 lowercase hex
new CorrelationId($s);        // InvalidArgumentException when invalid
```

Use the same `deadlineHeader` name on the receiving middleware and the sending
client to share one deadline across a call chain.

## baggage (0.3.0)

```php
$codec = new Rasuvaeff\Context\WireCodec(['tenant' => TenantId::class]);   // TenantId implements WireValue
new ContextMiddleware(timeout: 5.0, wireCodec: $codec, baggageHeader: 'baggage');
new ContextClient($guzzle, wireCodec: $codec);          // ONLY for clients calling your own services
new PreflightClient($psr18, $ctx, wireCodec: $codec);
```

- In: allow-listed aliases via `fromWire()`; invalid/unknown/malformed dropped,
  never thrown; header > 8192 bytes ignored; budget unaffected.
- Out: appended to existing `baggage`; existing members kept verbatim, an
  existing key never overridden; percent-encoded; 8192 bytes / 180 members.
- Leak warning: baggage goes with EVERY request of that client.
